title: Injective-resolution and derived connecting maps agree
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with enough injectives, let $M$ be an object, and let $0\to A\to B\to C\to0$ be a short exact sequence, with distinguished triangle $A[0]\to B[0]\to C[0]\xrightarrow{w}A[0][1]$ of [lem-sf-derived-ses-triangle]. Define $\operatorname{Ext}^n_{\mathcal A}(M,-)$ both as the right derived functors of $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(M,-)$ computed by injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and as $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(M[0],-[0][n])$ [def-pc-ext]. Under the canonical comparison between these descriptions [lem-weil-pbc-ext-via-injective-resolution], the connecting morphism $\operatorname{Ext}^n_{\mathcal A}(M,C)\to\operatorname{Ext}^{n+1}_{\mathcal A}(M,A)$ in the injective-resolution long exact sequence for $\operatorname{Ext}^n_{\mathcal A}(M,-)$ is the homology connecting morphism induced by this distinguished triangle in the derived category, i.e. the connecting morphism of the long exact sequence of the homological functor $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(M[0],-)$ [lem-sp-long-exact-of-triangle], $\xi\mapsto w[n]\circ\xi$.

source.place: Tags 05TE and 06XR: right-derived functors form the canonical delta-functor, and Ext is computed by injective resolutions and identified with derived-category morphisms

proof.text: Extend the prescribed horseshoe maps from natural to integer degrees. For nonnegative degrees transport splittingOfInjective through the canonical degree isomorphisms; below zero all three complexes vanish, giving the zero splitting. The splittings imply short exactness of the extended row.

The augmentations define a morphism from the single-object short exact row to the extended row. Apply Mathlib triangleOfSESδ_naturality and identify the latter boundary using the cone/split comparison. Transport the singleFunctor comparisons and invert the augmentation quasi-isomorphisms.

Transport c,b,a to the integer resolutions and apply the split cocycle boundary formula. Rewrite both extMk homs using the Mathlib injective-resolution roof formula. Associativity of shifted composition and the inverse-augmentation boundary square identify the two sides. The preadditiveCoyoneda homologySequenceδ formula is exactly this shifted composition.

lean.statement: theorem extMk_resolution_connecting_eq_triangle {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [EnoughInjectives C] {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact) (M : C) (RA : InjectiveResolution S.X₁) (RB : InjectiveResolution S.X₂) (RC : InjectiveResolution S.X₃) (i : RA.cocomplex ⟶ RB.cocomplex) (p : RB.cocomplex ⟶ RC.cocomplex) (hip : i ≫ p = 0) (hιi : RA.ι ≫ i = (CochainComplex.single₀ C).map S.f ≫ RB.ι) (hιp : RB.ι ≫ p = (CochainComplex.single₀ C).map S.g ≫ RC.ι) (hexact : ∀ k : ℕ, ((ShortComplex.mk i p hip).map (HomologicalComplex.eval C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) k)).ShortExact) (n : ℕ) (c : M ⟶ RC.cocomplex.X n) (hc : c ≫ RC.cocomplex.d n (n + 1) = 0) (b : M ⟶ RB.cocomplex.X n) (hb : b ≫ p.f n = c) (a : M ⟶ RA.cocomplex.X (n + 1)) (ha : a ≫ RA.cocomplex.d (n + 1) (n + 1 + 1) = 0) (hba : b ≫ RB.cocomplex.d n (n + 1) = a ≫ i.f (n + 1)) : letI := HasExt.standard C letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard C (preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (op ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj M))).homologySequenceδ hS.singleTriangle (n : ℤ) ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) (by omega) (RC.extMk c (n + 1) rfl hc).hom = (RA.extMk a (n + 1 + 1) rfl ha).hom
